verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I say, Pharaoh, Pharaoh, ooohh baby
Let my people go, Uh Huh, Uh Huh! Yeah, yeah, yeah!

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Pharaoh, Pharaoh, ooohh baby
Let my people, Uh Huh, Uh Huh! Yeah, yeah, yeah!

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Well a burnin' bush told me the other day
That I should come over here and stay.

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
To get my people out of Pharaoh's hand,
And lead them all into the Promised Land!

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
So me and God's people going to the Red Sea
And Pharaoh's army is coming after me.

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I raise my rod, stuck it in the sand,
And all of God's people walk across dry land.
